fields.label: Shift
fields.description: The hours a person takes work. To give someone this shift, open their Credit Weighted or Weighted Distribution assignment rule and pick it in the Work Shift column of its Users grid. Someone with no shift takes work whenever the rule is open.
What the team calls it, such as Morning or Night.
fields.label: Shift Name
Grain
fields.description: Leave a field blank to match any. An assignment rule can use this shift only when its grain is covered here.

fields.label: Product Line
fields.description: Applies to this product line only. Blank means every product line.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Applies to this group only. Blank means every group.

fields.label: Program
fields.description: Applies to this program only. Blank means every program.

fields.label: Working Hours
fields.description: One row for each day the shift runs. An end time earlier than the start time runs past midnight and counts as the day it starts, so Monday 22:00 to 06:00 ends on Tuesday morning. Two rows on the same day make a split shift.
